The generator 415V ACB fails to move back to the normal operating position from the maintenance / isolated position.  It appears some mechanical linkages are preventing it to go back to the normal position,  The switchgear is circa 50 years old. 
I doubt there would be any spares for this type of switchgear due to it age.  It really requires a new type 415V Board replacing this 50 year old item.  We are unable to carry out4hour load bank tests on the standby generator
field_16:
We are unable to carry out yearly 4 hour load bank tests on the generator.  If the ACB is put into the maintenance / isolated position it requires 2 SAP’s and a lot of effort (2 hrs minimum) to put the ACB back into the normal position.
This ACB is circa 50 years only and should not be operated as there are little or no maintenance records or any maintenance having been carried out on this switchgear.  It is a potentially accident waiting to happen with such a old piece of switchgear.

field_28:
There have been several instances where corrosion has resulted in early replacement of the oil cooling radiators on transformers supplied by Areva (now GE) fitted with radiators supplied by TTP Technologies. Prior to 2009, TTP Technologies was restricted to offering only manual thermal spray galvanising and/ or zinc rich painted product.  (Note that this means the coolers supplied did not in fact meet tech spec in place at the time & the supplier did not note this as a non-compliance).  Since 2009 TTP Technologies has been able to offer Hot Dip Galvanising to its protective coatings of oil cooling radiators.  I believe there was an OESB (? in 2020) relating to this.
Works at USKM in 2018/19 came in at ~£40k per radiator bank.

field_15: OESB 16/2016 Modification of IC Hapam Earth switches to remove TL. The driver is to rectify a design flaw in this variant of earth switch which allows the mechanism to 'roll back' and partially open it main current carrying contacts, reducing the effective short circuit withstand capability from 63kA to 16kA. Fitting a braked motor will prevent 'roll back' when full closed and remove a longstanding technical limitation. There are also two other modifications requiring fitting of an uprated braid and an earth connection for the main moving arm when fully open (to prevent induced charge build up).

field_15: The GRAI-KEMS 1 and 2 circuits are cooled by a tunnel ventilation system (TVCMS) comprising of 24 fans which where installed in 2010. field_16: This equipment is now operating outside of its intended design and as there has been no routine maintenance carried out it is unknown what damage has resulted from this 'overuse' and how much longer the equipment will last.
